title: Headless command lifetime is configured before launch
verification: Claude launch environment declares BASH_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS=3600000 through the shared native environment builder. A foreground timeout does not extend moved background lifetime. Explicit background calls set their own timeout; subagents inherit the process setting and use foreground Bash. Codex and Cursor defer this Claude-only setting because no equivalent limit is documented. Released relay wait evidence is still required.
